B. BRIEF DESCRIPTIONS

Jiangxi, Hunan, Fujian, Guangdong Provinces

Intensity was assessed based on Mercalli Intensity Scale. Felt at many places including

south Jiangxi, south Fujian, east Guangdong and east Hunan. The felt area is elliptical,
measured 530 km east-west and 450 km north-south. The total area is about 200 000 km’.
